correctness.rationale: The exact outward tangent-normal gaps give area A=4 sum tan(Delta_i/2) and H=sec(max Delta_i/2)−1. At fixed maximum gap M, Jensen strictly minimizes area with remaining m−1 equal gaps and Karamata maximizes it at k=floor(L/M) saturated gaps plus remainder; positivity gives the upper-attainment transition exactly at M<L/(m−1), with equal-gap boundary. Convex connectivity yields the complete attainable interval. For random independent phases Dirichlet(1,...,1) gaps imply area mean pi+pi³/[8(m+1)(m+2)]+O(m^-4), variance 5pi^6/(32m^5), and joint independent normal/Gumbel limit by exponential influence function E³−18E+12 and exclusion of rare maximum tails. Analytic marginal and joint limit proof checked, not inferred from simulation. Independently tested area envelope against 240 random gap vectors in m=2,3,5,10.
